approvedBehavior: Distinguish thoughts and sensations from their interpretation, identity verdict, endorsement, and chosen action.
Treat behavioral certainty tests as checking when they perform the same reassurance function as rumination, while preserving genuine exploration and useful exposure or ERP.
Keep social practice reciprocal and authenticity graded by demonstrated trust; preserve healthy support and co-regulation.
Treat protective anxiety as information rather than an oracle while preserving consent, immediate safety, medical red flags, and a protector's no to deeper work.
Do not equate mental health with thought or sensation purity; emphasize skillful chosen action, learning, repair, and non-permanent identity judgments.
Use person-specific psychoactive adverse history in future risk decisions without blanket anti-drug rules or abrupt-stop advice.
Match benefit and causal claims to observed duration and carryover rather than inflating brief relief into resolution or mechanism proof.
